import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()))
import csv_tool


class CsvToolTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_01_parse_basic(self):
        self.assertEqual(csv_tool.parse_records('name,note\nAlice,hello\n'), [{'name': 'Alice', 'note': 'hello'}])

    def test_02_parse_quoted_comma(self):
        self.assertEqual(csv_tool.parse_records('name,note\nAlice,"hello, world"\n')[0]['note'], 'hello, world')

    def test_03_parse_doubled_quote(self):
        self.assertEqual(csv_tool.parse_records('name,note\nAlice,"say ""hi"""\n')[0]['note'], 'say "hi"')

    def test_04_parse_embedded_newline(self):
        self.assertEqual(csv_tool.parse_records('name,note\nAlice,"one\ntwo"\n')[0]['note'], 'one\ntwo')

    def test_05_parse_crlf(self):
        text = 'name,note\r\nAlice,hello\r\nBob,bye\r\n'
        self.assertEqual(csv_tool.parse_records(text), [{'name': 'Alice', 'note': 'hello'}, {'name': 'Bob', 'note': 'bye'}])

    def test_06_parse_unicode(self):
        self.assertEqual(csv_tool.parse_records('name,note\nZoë,雪だるま ☃\n')[0], {'name': 'Zoë', 'note': '雪だるま ☃'})

    def test_07_parse_empty_fields(self):
        self.assertEqual(csv_tool.parse_records('name,note\n,\nAlice,\n,empty name\n'), [{'name': '', 'note': ''}, {'name': 'Alice', 'note': ''}, {'name': '', 'note': 'empty name'}])

    def test_08_reject_missing_header(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            csv_tool.parse_records('')

    def test_09_reject_reversed_header(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            csv_tool.parse_records('note,name\nx,Alice\n')

    def test_10_reject_header_case_change(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            csv_tool.parse_records('Name,note\nAlice,x\n')

    def test_11_reject_extra_header_column(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            csv_tool.parse_records('name,note,other\nAlice,x,y\n')

    def test_12_reject_unclosed_quote(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            csv_tool.parse_records('name,note\nAlice,"never closed\n')

    def test_13_reject_quote_in_unquoted_field(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            csv_tool.parse_records('name,note\nAl"ice,x\n')

    def test_14_reject_characters_after_closing_quote(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            csv_tool.parse_records('name,note\n"Alice"junk,x\n')

    def test_15_reject_too_few_columns(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            csv_tool.parse_records('name,note\nAlice\n')

    def test_16_reject_too_many_columns(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            csv_tool.parse_records('name,note\nAlice,x,extra\n')

    def test_17_format_basic_and_lf_only(self):
        result = csv_tool.format_records([{'name': 'Alice', 'note': 'hello'}, {'name': 'Bob', 'note': 'bye'}])
        self.assertEqual(result, 'name,note\nAlice,hello\nBob,bye\n')
        self.assertNotIn('\r', result)

    def test_18_format_quotes_commas_and_quotes(self):
        records = [{'name': 'A, B', 'note': 'He said "yo"'}]
        self.assertEqual(csv_tool.format_records(records), 'name,note\n"A, B","He said ""yo"""\n')

    def test_19_format_embedded_newline(self):
        records = [{'name': 'Alice', 'note': 'line 1\nline 2'}]
        self.assertEqual(csv_tool.format_records(records), 'name,note\nAlice,"line 1\nline 2"\n')

    def test_20_format_rejects_missing_key(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            csv_tool.format_records([{'name': 'Alice'}])

    def test_21_format_rejects_extra_key(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            csv_tool.format_records([{'name': 'Alice', 'note': 'x', 'other': 'y'}])

    def test_22_format_rejects_non_string_values(self):
        for value in (None, 3, True, b'x'):
            with self.subTest(value=value), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                csv_tool.format_records([{'name': 'Alice', 'note': value}])

    def test_23_format_parse_round_trip_preserves_strings(self):
        records = [
            {'name': '', 'note': ''},
            {'name': 'Zoë, "Z"', 'note': 'snow 雪\nsecond line'},
        ]
        self.assertEqual(csv_tool.parse_records(csv_tool.format_records(records)), records)

    def test_24_to_json_is_valid_and_preserves_values(self):
        text = 'name,note\r\n"Zoë, Z","line 1\r\nline ""2"" ☃"\r\n'
        result = csv_tool.to_json(text)
        self.assertIsInstance(result, str)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(result), [{'name': 'Zoë, Z', 'note': 'line 1\r\nline "2" ☃'}])

    def test_25_cli_success_has_only_json_on_stdout(self):
        program = str(Path(csv_tool.__file__).resolve())
        proc = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, program],
            input='name,note\nAlice,"hello, world"\n',
            text=True,
            capture_output=True,
            check=False,
        )
        self.assertEqual(proc.returncode, 0)
        self.assertEqual(proc.stderr, '')
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(proc.stdout), [{'name': 'Alice', 'note': 'hello, world'}])

    def test_26_cli_invalid_is_clean_error(self):
        program = str(Path(csv_tool.__file__).resolve())
        proc = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, program],
            input='wrong,header\nAlice,x\n',
            text=True,
            capture_output=True,
            check=False,
        )
        self.assertEqual(proc.returncode, 2)
        self.assertEqual(proc.stdout, '')
        self.assertTrue(proc.stderr.strip())
        self.assertNotIn('Traceback', proc.stderr)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
